blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said on Thursday that individuals who take wacky photos inside the session hall could receive warnings, stressing that both the Senate and the hall are “sacred.” “The session hall and the Senate are sacred because this is where we craft many important laws and discuss important issues, so we must respect this institution. It is not right to do something ridiculous inside our institution,” Gatchalian said in an interview at the Senate. Atty. Jay Tolosa, a member of the prosecution panel in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, posted photos on social media showing […]...
